cases.name: Mood before destination
cases.prompt: I want foggy bookshops and train windows in autumn. I haven't picked a destination.
expectations: Creates an unplaced autumn wishboard card.
Retains bookshops and train windows as motifs.
Labels any proposed towns as suggestions.
Gives a shortlisting milestone rather than a booking.

cases.name: Budget without rates
cases.prompt: Our two-person spring trip has a $2,400 USD cap for four nights. No live fares. Give a cost-planning card.
expectations: Captures currency, two travelers, four nights and spring.
Separates unpriced categories from known costs.
Avoids reporting live fares or a reservation.

cases.name: Separate themed dreams
cases.prompt: I booked my coast trip but my forest retreat is just an idea. The photos are unavailable; I named them tide and fern.
expectations: Creates separate coastal and forest cards.
Marks only the coast trip booked.
Leaves the forest retreat in dreaming status.
Records the two labels without inventing image details.
